summary: Reject new writes of ignored agent authority blocks while preserving historical readers; consolidate the universal-grants roadmap under native run authority

replay.detail: Historical KDL parsing, immutable claim bytes, replicated admission and replay remain unchanged.

rules.detail: New publications and local claims reject mission-authority, queue-authority, seat-authority and agent-authority on agents, including mission-authority none and declarations nested in missions or revisions. Mission authority for run actors is unchanged; this does not introduce universal agent, expiry or revocation enforcement.

compatibility.detail: New writes return retired-agent-authority. Historical records remain readable and previewable. Producers must remove ignored agent blocks before publishing to an upgraded daemon.

manual.detail: Remove ignored agent authority blocks from authored declarations before publication. Coordinate external producer rollout before deploying the write rejection.

recovery.detail: Remove the ignored blocks and republish; do not rewrite historical claims.
